title.zh: 授予 Julio Benemerito 在北伊罗戈省境内的 Pagudpud 与 Bangui 两个市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许权法案
title.en: An Act Granting Julio Benemerito a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipalities of Pagudpud and Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte
title.orig: An Act Granting Julio Benemerito a Franchise for An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipalities of Pagudpud and Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Julio Benemerito để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Pagudpud và Bangui, tỉnh Ilocos Norte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Julio Benemerito เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Pagudpud และ Bangui, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Julio Benemerito untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Pagudpud dan Bangui, Provinsi Ilocos Norte
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Julio Benemerito untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Pagudpud dan Bangui, Wilayah Ilocos Norte

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Julio Benemerito, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, operate and maintain an Electric light, heat and power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power of the Municipalities of Pagudpud and Bangui, Province of Ilocos Norte: Provided, That the holder of the franchise herein granted shall start the operation thereof within two years from the approval of this Act.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase secure electric heat and power from the National Power Corporation, the latter is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact business for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates subject to the approval of the Public Service Commission

In consideration of the franchise and rights hereby granted, the grantee shall pay a franchise tax equal to five per centum of the gross income, three per centum of which shall accrue to the National Government and two per centum to the municipality where the franchise is in operation.

It is expressly provided that should the Government desire to operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender his franchise and turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at fair market value, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without the Executive approval, August 26, 1972.
